say:2:1122218001:1.text: Silverbeak, how are they doing? Grayhorn's wounds looked really really bad! Chippy was so worried!
say:2:1122218001:1.source_cn: 银喙，烈爪和老憨的伤势还好吗？在马场的时候老憨一直喊疼...

say:3:1122218002:1.text: They'll be fine. A few days' rest and they'll be back to their normal cheerful selves.
say:3:1122218002:1.source_cn: 不碍大事，休息几天就能活蹦乱跳的了。

say:4:1122218003:1.text: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!
say:4:1122218003:1.source_cn: 不过他们带回来的情报……光凭经验判断，我都能知道是假的...
say:4:1122218003:1.male: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!
say:4:1122218003:1.female: But the intel they brought back... I could instantly tell it was bogus. You did a way better job, newbie!

say:5:1122218004:1.text: Once they're both better, I'll give them a proper lesson on gathering intel so they don't embarrass us again.
say:5:1122218004:1.source_cn: 等他们伤好，我该给他们也好好上一门情报课，免得出去丢人现眼。

say:6:1122218005:1.text: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
say:6:1122218005:1.source_cn: 不管怎么样，你算是成功掌握了获取情报的技能，记得要多加训练。
say:6:1122218005:1.male: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
say:6:1122218005:1.female: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.

choice_prompt:7:1122218005.text: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.source_cn: 不管怎么样，你算是成功掌握了获取情报的技能，记得要多加训练。
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.male: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.
choice_prompt:7:1122218005.female: Anyways, you've mastered the art of gathering intel.

say:8:1122218007:1.text: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.
say:8:1122218007:1.source_cn: 之后我会根据你的情报，进行下一步计划。等他们养好了伤，...
say:8:1122218007:1.male: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.
say:8:1122218007:1.female: I'll come up with a plan based on your intel. Once those two have recovered, we'll proceed to the next step.

say:9:1122218008:1.text: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?
say:9:1122218008:1.source_cn: 在那之前，你也好好休息一阵子吧。
say:9:1122218008:1.male: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?
say:9:1122218008:1.female: But for now, why don't you go rest for a bit?

say:11:1122218006:1.text: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
say:11:1122218006:1.source_cn: 哈，这话可别让他们听见。
say:11:1122218006:1.male: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
say:11:1122218006:1.female: Hah, don't let the other two hear you say that!
